find_accelerator_nodes: find nodes in a PyTorch FX graph supported by an accelerator backend
split_graph_module: split a PyTorch FX GraphModule into accelerator and CPU submodules
preview_node_support: preview which nodes in a graph are supported or unsupported by an accelerator operator
preview_split: preview a graph split including submodule sizes, PCIe bandwidth estimates, and bottleneck analysis
generate_submodule_inputs: generate inputs for targeted submodules by running the model with forward pre-hooks
